$doc: MIG-047 Phase 0b — installable models for Constellation Mind. This file is bundled as a Tauri resource (src-tauri/tauri.conf.json → bundle.resources). The Tauri-side model-install command reads it at startup; the install flow uses the URL pattern + final_sha256 to fetch + verify each model. Final SHA-256 values are TBD until the model-pipeline.yml workflow has been run once per model; the install command refuses to install any model whose sha256 begins with 'TBD' to avoid shipping an unverifiable download.

models.description: Qatar Computing Research Institute's Arabic-first 9B model, instruction-tuned, deliberately Sunni-aware. Continued pretraining of google/gemma-2-9b. Recommended bundled default for Constellation Mind.
models.description_ar: نموذج عربي ٩ مليار مُعامل من معهد قطر لبحوث الحوسبة (QCRI)، مُدرَّب على التعليمات، مُحاذى مع المنظور السُنّي. تدريب مكمَّل لنموذج google/gemma-2-9b. الموصى به افتراضيًا لـ Constellation Mind.
